notes.title: New Demo Patch: 0.3e8
notes.notes:
[p]Hi all, the long awaited bug fix patch for the Your Holy & Virtuous Heretic demo is finally dropping. This patch fixes all of the common bugs I'm aware of, including:
[/p][list][*][p]Accidentally exiting battles during the transition to daemon negotiation.[/p][/*][*][p]Doubled SP usage.[/p][/*][*][p]Incorrect damage values.[/p][/*][*][p]Bifrons accidentally 'summoning' himself instead of Avnas.[/p][/*][*][p]Incorrect number of attacks during the 'Beat Flurry' attack.[/p][/*][*][p]Progressing through the introduction without completing the required actions.[/p][/*][/list][p]I apologise for the long wait between the demo release and this patch. This will not be the final patch to the demo - while I am mainly focused on making the main game content at the moment, there will be another patch focused more on QOL improvements and polish, including controller support and key rebinding. As I'm balancing working on new content with producing those QOL improvements, I don't want to put out a specific ETA for that patch, but stay tuned!

Thank you to everyone who has played so far for your patience and support![/p]

notes.title: Bug Reporting
notes.notes: [p]As many of you have probably noticed, this demo is a pre-release demo, and it has some bugs. I'm working on fixing as many of these bugs as I'm aware of, but where possible it would be great to have some more information about the conditions leading to these bugs, and how common they are.[/p][p]For this reason, I've created this Google Form where you can report bugs, and attach relevant log files. [/p][p][url="https://forms.gle/wrUMrigc33g8umPe8"]https://forms.gle/wrUMrigc33g8umPe8[/url][/p][p]Whether you submit anything or not, thank you for playing Your Holy & Virtuous Heretic! I really appreciate the support and engagement with the demo, it means a lot to me as the developer of a relatively small project.[/p]

notes.title: I defeated a bird by talking to it about the Bible in this lo-fi first-person RPG where you're a 19th century daemon summoner
notes.notes: Watching the trailer for Your Holy & Virtuous Heretic during the Frosty Games Fest, my first thought was of Dread Delusion, the indie micro-Morrowind. Then the combat started and I remembered Felvidek, the RPG set in early modern Hungary. But overall, I was reminded of the psychedelic historical movie A Field in England. If it's not clear, these are all top-notch things to bring to mind... Read more.
